senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בה , v. בהי) to hurry, be excited, anxious. Part. pass. בָּהוּל excited, pressed.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 11a">Pes. 11ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>אדם ב׳ הוא וכ׳</he> man is excited when his property is at stake.
<cite ref="Pesachim 72b:21">Ib. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>זמנו ב׳</he> his time (for doing the thing) is pressed (it cannot be postponed).
<cite ref="Yoma 85a">Yoma 85ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ב׳ על מתו</he> anxious to save his dead relative from the fire.

senses.gloss: to agitate, frighten. Y. Yoma VI, 43ᶜ bot. למה אתה מְבַהֲלֵינוּ why dost thou agitate us.

units: Num. R. s. 14 (ref. to tibbahel, Koh. VIII, 3) אל תִּתְבָּהֵל וכ׳ be not intimidated by his wrath, Ib. לא נ׳ מן מעשיה he was not carried away by her (tempting) actions.
<cite ref="Ecclesiastes 8:3">Ib.</cite> <he>לא נ׳ מפנאי וכ׳</he> he was not confounded on account of his being alone in the house.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 36:1">Pesik. R. s. 36</cite> <he>מתרעשים ומִתְבַּהֲלִים</he> were in commotion and alarm.—

senses.gloss: , or Pual מְבוֹהָל confounded, hard to pronounce or remember.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 14b">Gitt. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>שמותיהן מוב׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מבו׳</he>) their names are bewildering, beginning with Arda, Arta, Phile.—[<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 9">Deut. R. s. 9</cite> <he>דעתו מובלגת</he>, read <he>מוּבְהֶלֶת</he> his mind is confused, he cannot collect himself for prayer.]
